chapter.title: Mind Spark: The Two Lenses of Wisdom
chapter.crown_connection: The first light for the Crown of Life is not won by defeating fear. It is discovered when courage listens to fear, tests what is true, and chooses a hopeful next step.
chapter.theme: I can notice a difficult thought, learn from its signal, and choose a grounded path forward.

content_policy.principle: Thoughts are visitors and signals, never a verdict about the player. Fear may protect; hope may guide. Wisdom listens to both.

faith.spiritual_frame: The Maker already knows and loves the player; wisdom helps reveal gifts already placed within them.

universal.spiritual_frame: The player already has worth; wisdom helps reveal strengths already growing within them.

prologue.title: The Crown That Cannot Be Copied
prologue.location: ARTÉA Castle — Hall of Unnamed Stars
prologue.purpose: Establish the Crown of Life journey and assure the player that they are discovering strengths, not repairing a broken self.
prologue.reason: The Castle can shape a unique crown only from freely discovered wisdom, harmony, and creativity.

guardian_dialogue.faith: The Maker knows your name and has placed light within you. Nothing in you is a broken piece. Come discover the first light for your Crown of Life.
guardian_dialogue.universal: Your name and your light belong in this universe. Nothing in you is a broken piece. Come discover the first light for your Crown of Life.

quests.title: The Signal Observatory
quests.purpose: Learn that a difficult thought can be noticed without being obeyed or erased.
quests.reason: A storm of thought-signals hides the road; the first gate opens only when both lenses observe the same signal.

guardian_dialogue.faith: A fearful thought may knock loudly, but it cannot rename the person God created.
guardian_dialogue.universal: A fearful thought may knock loudly, but it cannot decide who you are.

tasks.title: Enter Through Two Doors
tasks.purpose: Introduce the technology Alarm Lens and nature-magic Hope Lens as equally necessary perspectives.
tasks.reason: Neither door can power the observatory alone.

guardian_dialogue.faith: Truth and hope are companions. Let each lens show part of what the Maker can see in full.
guardian_dialogue.universal: Careful noticing and grounded hope are companions. Let each lens show part of the whole.

tasks.science_consequence: The Alarm player calibrates a blue signal array and reveals the cloud's exact words.
tasks.magic_consequence: The Hope player grows a listening vine around the signal so it can be approached safely.

failure_free_encouragement.faith: There is no hurry; wisdom can wait with you.
failure_free_encouragement.universal: There is no hurry; wisdom grows at your pace.

reflection.prompt: What did the two doors need?

tasks.title: Notice the Visitor
tasks.purpose: Create distance between the player and an authored difficult thought.
tasks.reason: The cloud becomes navigable only after it is named as a visitor rather than the player's identity.

guardian_dialogue.faith: You can say, 'A thought is here,' and remember that you are still known beyond it.
guardian_dialogue.universal: You can say, 'A thought is here,' without making it your whole story.

tasks.science_consequence: A scan frame changes the label from identity statement to visiting signal.
tasks.magic_consequence: Wind-leaves move the cloud from over the player to a visible place beside the path.

failure_free_encouragement.faith: Not sure is an honest answer, and honesty belongs in wisdom.
failure_free_encouragement.universal: Not sure is a complete answer; noticing is enough for now.

reflection.prompt: Which description feels safest to practise?
choices: I can look from a distance

tasks.title: Map What It Changes
tasks.purpose: Build vocabulary for a thought's possible effect without demanding personal disclosure.
tasks.reason: The compass needs a curated effect before it can reveal a route through the storm.

guardian_dialogue.faith: Understanding is not agreement. You may notice what a thought does without believing what it says.
guardian_dialogue.universal: Understanding is not agreement. You may notice an effect without accepting the thought as fact.

tasks.science_consequence: The array visualizes authored options such as louder, smaller, rushed, or unsure.
tasks.magic_consequence: A ring of flowers changes posture and symbol for the selected effect.

failure_free_encouragement.faith: Every offered answer keeps you accompanied.
failure_free_encouragement.universal: Every offered answer opens the same onward path.

reflection.prompt: What can careful noticing give us?

tasks.title: Synchronize the First Gate
tasks.purpose: Teach the cooperative rhythm of independent action followed by a shared result.
tasks.reason: The first gate responds only when measured signal and living light arrive together.

guardian_dialogue.faith: Courage does not mean walking alone. Join your lights when you are ready.
guardian_dialogue.universal: Courage can be cooperative. Join your lights when you are ready.

tasks.science_consequence: The array projects half of a stable bridge equation.
tasks.magic_consequence: Roots form the missing half and hold the bridge in place.

failure_free_encouragement.faith: A missed moment is only another invitation to try together.
failure_free_encouragement.universal: A missed moment resets gently; try together whenever you are ready.

reflection.prompt: What opened the gate?

quests.title: The Echo Forest
quests.purpose: Discover that fear can carry a protective question while still exaggerating danger.
quests.reason: The archive has mistaken every possibility for a certainty; its predictions must be sorted, not destroyed.

guardian_dialogue.faith: Fear may try to protect you. We can thank the warning, test it with truth, and refuse to let it become your master.
guardian_dialogue.universal: Fear may try to protect you. We can hear the warning, test the evidence, and keep the choice in your hands.

tasks.title: Collect, Do Not Chase
tasks.purpose: Practise calm observation instead of urgency.
tasks.reason: Three slow-moving signal orbs contain enough evidence to unlock the sorter.

guardian_dialogue.faith: You do not have to catch every worry. Receive only what you are ready to examine.
guardian_dialogue.universal: You do not have to catch every worry. Examine one signal at a time.

tasks.science_consequence: The Alarm Lens samples signal strength without starting a countdown.
tasks.magic_consequence: The Hope Lens creates resting branches where unchosen signals can wait.

failure_free_encouragement.faith: The signal will circle back; nothing good is lost by resting.
failure_free_encouragement.universal: The signal will circle back; pausing does not cost progress.

reflection.prompt: How many thoughts must be solved at once?

tasks.title: Fact, Possibility, or Unsure
tasks.purpose: Introduce uncertainty as a valid category between belief and rejection.
tasks.reason: The archive stabilizes when possibilities are no longer displayed as certain facts.

guardian_dialogue.faith: Truth does not fear the words 'I do not know yet.'
guardian_dialogue.universal: Clear thinking has room for 'I do not know yet.'

tasks.science_consequence: A prism terminal routes an authored card into fact, possibility, or unsure.
tasks.magic_consequence: Three seedbeds receive matching symbols and grow without ranking the choice.

failure_free_encouragement.faith: You may move any card again; learning is welcome here.
failure_free_encouragement.universal: Every card can be reconsidered; this is practice, not a test.

reflection.prompt: Which choice leaves room to learn?

tasks.title: Find the Helpful Question
tasks.purpose: Translate alarm into an actionable, non-catastrophic question.
tasks.reason: The archive core can power a safety beacon when its warning becomes a question rather than a verdict.

guardian_dialogue.faith: Ask what care is needed, then let truth—not panic—answer.
guardian_dialogue.universal: Ask what support or preparation is useful, then choose the next small action.

tasks.science_consequence: The warning 'Everything will go wrong' is routed to curated questions such as 'What can I prepare?'
tasks.magic_consequence: Thorned vines soften into protective arches when a grounded question is selected.

failure_free_encouragement.faith: If no question fits, choose 'I need a guide'; asking for help is wisdom.
failure_free_encouragement.universal: If no question fits, choose 'I can ask for help'; support is a valid next step.

reflection.prompt: What can a warning become?

tasks.title: Power the Caution Beacon
tasks.purpose: Celebrate protective wisdom without rewarding avoidance.
tasks.reason: The transformed signal becomes a beacon marking safe choices for both lenses.

guardian_dialogue.faith: The warning has found its right-sized place: a servant of wisdom, not a ruler of your story.
guardian_dialogue.universal: The warning now has a right-sized job: offering information while you remain the chooser.

tasks.science_consequence: A calibrated beacon projects safe route markers instead of threat alarms.
tasks.magic_consequence: Fireflies carry those markers into the surrounding forest path.

failure_free_encouragement.faith: The beacon accepts any steady rhythm; perfection is not required.
failure_free_encouragement.universal: Any steady rhythm completes the beacon; precision is not scored.

reflection.prompt: What job should the Alarm Lens have?

quests.title: The Cross-Seam Relay
quests.purpose: Choose believable hope that acknowledges difficulty instead of pretending everything is easy.
quests.reason: The garden grows from honest next steps; forced bright answers turn to glass and cannot take root.

guardian_dialogue.faith: Hope can tell the truth about a hard road and still trust that you will not walk it alone.
guardian_dialogue.universal: Hope can acknowledge a hard road and still find one possible next step.

tasks.title: Carry the Warning Seed
tasks.purpose: Preserve the useful part of the Alarm Lens discovery.
tasks.reason: The garden cannot grow authentic hope unless it receives the real concern from the archive.

guardian_dialogue.faith: Bring the honest concern with you. Hope does not need you to hide it.
guardian_dialogue.universal: Bring the honest concern with you. Grounded hope starts with what is real.

tasks.science_consequence: The Alarm Lens compresses the protective question into a stable light-seed.
tasks.magic_consequence: The Hope Lens prepares soil that accepts the seed without changing its label.

failure_free_encouragement.faith: The seed cannot be dropped or broken; pause whenever you need.
failure_free_encouragement.universal: The seed waits safely whenever you pause.

reflection.prompt: What makes hope grounded?

tasks.title: Choose a Growing Thought
tasks.purpose: Practise selecting a curated, compassionate response that remains believable.
tasks.reason: Only a player-chosen response can wake the dormant garden path.

guardian_dialogue.faith: Choose words you can carry: 'I can take one step,' 'I am learning,' or 'I can ask for help.'
guardian_dialogue.universal: Choose words you can carry: 'I can take one step,' 'I am learning,' or 'I can ask for help.'

tasks.science_consequence: The Alarm Lens checks that the response promises no impossible certainty.
tasks.magic_consequence: The selected phrase grows into a distinct plant; all choices are equally luminous.

failure_free_encouragement.faith: You may choose 'more time'; patience is not failure.
failure_free_encouragement.universal: You may choose 'more time'; the journey will wait.

reflection.prompt: Which kind of hope can travel with you?

tasks.title: Weave the Living Circuit
tasks.purpose: Make mutual dependence visible through an original cooperative traversal.
tasks.reason: Metal rails conduct the plan, but living roots give it flexibility; together they span the ravine.

guardian_dialogue.faith: Different gifts can serve one loving purpose. Offer what your side can give.
guardian_dialogue.universal: Different strengths can solve one problem. Offer what your side can give.

tasks.science_consequence: The Alarm player rotates circuit bridges to route energy toward each root anchor.
tasks.magic_consequence: The Hope player grows flexible root spans wherever energy reaches an anchor.

failure_free_encouragement.faith: The bridge remembers every true connection; try the next piece together.
failure_free_encouragement.universal: Correct connections remain lit, and the next attempt has no penalty.

reflection.prompt: Why did the bridge need both sides?

tasks.title: Give the Cloud a Resting Place
tasks.purpose: Model regulation as making room for a thought rather than destroying it.
tasks.reason: The cloud must rest beside the path so the player can proceed while it remains safely acknowledged.

guardian_dialogue.faith: You need not banish every cloud to keep walking in light.
guardian_dialogue.universal: A cloud can remain nearby without covering the whole sky.

tasks.science_consequence: A containment frame defines a calm boundary without locking or deleting the signal.
tasks.magic_consequence: A broad tree canopy becomes a gentle resting place for the cloud.

failure_free_encouragement.faith: Any resting place you choose is received with care.
failure_free_encouragement.universal: There is no wrong resting place; choose the distance that feels comfortable.

reflection.prompt: What happened to the difficult thought?

quests.title: The Role-Exchange Storm
quests.purpose: Build empathy and flexible thinking by requiring each player to experience the other role.
quests.reason: The meridian will reveal the Wisdom Constellation only after technology listens like nature and nature examines like technology.

guardian_dialogue.faith: Wisdom grows when we listen beyond our first view. Exchange places without losing who you are.
guardian_dialogue.universal: Wisdom grows when we practise another perspective. Exchange places without losing your own.

tasks.title: Leave a Guide for Your Partner
tasks.purpose: Make the role transition supportive rather than surprising.
tasks.reason: Each lens can leave one authored tip that becomes the incoming player's guide symbol.

guardian_dialogue.faith: A gift becomes brighter when it helps another person begin.
guardian_dialogue.universal: A strength becomes more useful when it helps another person begin.

tasks.science_consequence: The Alarm player selects a control diagram for scanning or routing.
tasks.magic_consequence: The Hope player selects a gesture diagram for growing or sheltering.

failure_free_encouragement.faith: Every guide is generous; none is graded.
failure_free_encouragement.universal: Every guide is useful; none is graded.

reflection.prompt: What helps someone try a new role?

tasks.title: Cross the Living Seam
tasks.purpose: Turn the mandatory role swap into a clear story event.
tasks.reason: The seam opens only when both players consent to exchange and confirm readiness.

guardian_dialogue.faith: Step across when both hearts are ready; wisdom never needs to force the crossing.
guardian_dialogue.universal: Cross when both players are ready; cooperation includes consent.

tasks.science_consequence: Control glyphs migrate across the split while retaining accessible labels.
tasks.magic_consequence: Two vines braid across the seam and exchange their glowing leaves.

failure_free_encouragement.faith: Waiting together is still part of the journey.
failure_free_encouragement.universal: The scene waits without penalty until both are ready.

reflection.prompt: What made the exchange possible?

tasks.title: Solve From the Other Side
tasks.purpose: Rehearse the full notice-and-choose loop using the exchanged roles.
tasks.reason: A second authored thought reveals different details to players who now carry the other lens.

guardian_dialogue.faith: A new viewpoint may reveal a gift you did not know you carried.
guardian_dialogue.universal: A new viewpoint may reveal a strength you did not know you could use.

tasks.science_consequence: The new Alarm player identifies the signal's effect and powers a truth array.
tasks.magic_consequence: The new Hope player selects a grounded response and grows a welcome vine.

failure_free_encouragement.faith: New roles take practice; every attempt is accompanied.
failure_free_encouragement.universal: New roles take practice; hints remain available without reducing progress.

reflection.prompt: What did the other lens help you notice?

tasks.title: Create the Shared Horizon
tasks.purpose: Integrate caution and hope into one wise action.
tasks.reason: The separate horizons align only when the protective question and grounded response point toward the same small step.

guardian_dialogue.faith: Wisdom has heard the warning and chosen hope. Let both lights become one path.
guardian_dialogue.universal: Wisdom has heard the warning and chosen a grounded path. Let both lenses guide the step.

tasks.science_consequence: The technological skyline projects the safe boundaries of the next action.
tasks.magic_consequence: The natural skyline grows the inviting pathway within those boundaries.

failure_free_encouragement.faith: The horizon realigns as often as needed.
failure_free_encouragement.universal: The horizon gently realigns after every attempt.

reflection.prompt: What is wisdom in this journey?

quests.title: The Wisdom Constellation
quests.purpose: Consolidate the chapter's skills and return the earned symbolic treasure to ARTÉA Castle.
quests.reason: The Star of Wisdom forms from the player's demonstrated sequence: Notice, Name, Choose, and Integrate.

guardian_dialogue.faith: You did not become worthy here; you discovered courage and wisdom already being formed within you.
guardian_dialogue.universal: You did not earn your worth here; you discovered courage and wisdom already growing within you.

tasks.title: Gather the Four Lights
tasks.purpose: Rehearse the sequence without testing recall or speed.
tasks.reason: Four journey symbols orbit separately until the player touches them in any order.

guardian_dialogue.faith: Your path matters more than a perfect pattern. Gather each light in your own way.
guardian_dialogue.universal: Your path matters more than a perfect pattern. Gather each light in your own way.

tasks.science_consequence: Alarm projects the Notice and Name symbols as navigable holograms.
tasks.magic_consequence: Hope grows the Choose and Integrate symbols as floating seed-lights.

failure_free_encouragement.faith: No light can be lost, and any order is welcomed.
failure_free_encouragement.universal: No light can be lost, and any order completes the memory.

reflection.prompt: Which light would you like nearby today?

tasks.title: Draw the Path Between Them
tasks.purpose: Give the player authorship of the constellation without judging artistic form.
tasks.reason: Connections, rather than a predetermined perfect shape, awaken the star.

guardian_dialogue.faith: The Maker delights in a path that is truly yours.
guardian_dialogue.universal: A path becomes meaningful because it is truly yours.

tasks.science_consequence: The Alarm Lens records which nodes are connected but assigns no score.
tasks.magic_consequence: The Hope Lens turns every valid connection into a unique flowering light trail.

failure_free_encouragement.faith: Every connected shape is received as complete.
failure_free_encouragement.universal: Every connected shape is accepted and can be remade.

reflection.prompt: What made this constellation yours?

tasks.title: Receive or Carry Beside You
tasks.purpose: Celebrate growth while preserving consent around body and spiritual imagery.
tasks.reason: The completed constellation condenses into the first treasure for the Crown of Life.

guardian_dialogue.faith: Receive the Star of Wisdom, or let it travel beside you. God's love does not depend on where you place it.
guardian_dialogue.universal: Receive the Star of Wisdom, or let it travel beside you. Your progress is equal in either choice.

tasks.science_consequence: A star compass registers the treasure exactly once and opens the home route.
tasks.magic_consequence: A gentle star-spirit offers to hover above, beside, or within the journey lantern.

failure_free_encouragement.faith: Choosing distance is fully honoured.
failure_free_encouragement.universal: Every placement choice grants the same completion.

reflection.prompt: Where should the Star travel?

tasks.title: Return the First Light
tasks.purpose: Connect Mind Spark to the complete Crown of Life journey without prematurely completing the crown.
tasks.reason: The Castle must preserve the Star until the Harmony Jewel and Creator's Light arrive in later worlds.

guardian_dialogue.faith: Carry this light home. The Maker will keep its story beside the gifts still waiting to be discovered.
guardian_dialogue.universal: Carry this light home. The Castle will keep its story beside the strengths still waiting to be discovered.

tasks.science_consequence: The Rainbow Galaxy Train plots a verified return route to the Castle.
tasks.magic_consequence: The constellation folds into a star-seed that illuminates one point of the unfinished crown.

failure_free_encouragement.faith: You may watch, shorten, or skip the journey home; the Star remains yours.
failure_free_encouragement.universal: You may watch, shorten, or skip the journey home; your progress remains complete.

reflection.prompt: What will the Star remind you?
choices: I can choose a next step

finale.title: The First Point of the Crown
finale.purpose: Celebrate Mind Spark while clearly promising the connected Heart Melody and Creator's Light journeys.
finale.reason: The Crown of Life needs three distinct treasures; the Star of Wisdom lights the route to the next kingdom but does not complete the Crown.

guardian_dialogue.faith: The Maker receives the story of your wisdom with joy. One light of your Crown now shines; your heart and creativity still have wonders to reveal.
guardian_dialogue.universal: The Castle receives the story of your wisdom with joy. One light of your Crown now shines; your heart and creativity still have wonders to reveal.

message.faith: You are known. You are loved. Courage can listen, truth can guide, and hope can choose the next step.
message.universal: You are known. You are valued. Courage can listen, truth can guide, and hope can choose the next step.
